title: Entity Swoop Attack Behavior
description: Allows an entity to attack using swoop attack behavior; Ideal for use with flying mobs. The behavior ends if the entity has a horizontal collision or gets hit.

damage_reach.title: Damage Reach
damage_reach.description: Added to the base size of the entity, to determine the target's maximum allowable distance, when trying to deal attack damage.

delay_range.title: Delay Range
delay_range.description:
Minimum and maximum cooldown time-range (in seconds) between each attempted swoop attack.

Properties:
• max (float) = 0
• min (float) = 0

defaultSnippets.label: Item Components FloatRange
defaultSnippets.description: Has minimum and maximum float values.

speed_multiplier.title: Speed Multiplier
speed_multiplier.description: During swoop attack behavior, this determines the multiplier the entity's speed is modified by when moving toward the target.

item_components_floatrange.title: Item Components FloatRange
item_components_floatrange.description: Has minimum and maximum float values.
